17//package com.google.zxing;
18
19use std::{fmt::Display, str::FromStr};
20
21#[cfg(feature = "serde")]
22use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
23
24/**
25 * Enumerates barcode formats known to this package. Please keep alphabetized.
26 *
27 * @author Sean Owen
28 */
29#[cfg_attr(feature = "serde", derive(Serialize, Deserialize))]
30#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Clone, Copy)]
31pub enum BarcodeFormat {
32    /** Aztec 2D barcode format. */
33    AZTEC,
34
35    /** CODABAR 1D format. */
36    CODABAR,
37
38    /** Code 39 1D format. */
39    CODE_39,
40
41    /** Code 93 1D format. */
42    CODE_93,
43
44    /** Code 128 1D format. */
45    CODE_128,
46
47    /** Data Matrix 2D barcode format. */
48    DATA_MATRIX,
49
50    /** EAN-8 1D format. */
51    EAN_8,
52
53    /** EAN-13 1D format. */
54    EAN_13,
55
56    /** ITF (Interleaved Two of Five) 1D format. */
57    ITF,
58
59    /** MaxiCode 2D barcode format. */
60    MAXICODE,
61
62    /** PDF417 format. */
63    PDF_417,
64
65    /** QR Code 2D barcode format. */
66    QR_CODE,
67
68    MICRO_QR_CODE,
69
70    RECTANGULAR_MICRO_QR_CODE,
71
72    /** RSS 14 */
73    RSS_14,
74
75    /** RSS EXPANDED */
76    RSS_EXPANDED,
77
78    /** TELEPEN */
79    TELEPEN,
80
81    /** UPC-A 1D format. */
82    UPC_A,
83
84    /** UPC-E 1D format. */
85    UPC_E,
86
87    /** UPC/EAN extension format. Not a stand-alone format. */
88    UPC_EAN_EXTENSION,
89
90    DXFilmEdge,
91
92    /// format not supported
93    UNSUPORTED_FORMAT,
94}
95
96impl Display for BarcodeFormat {
97    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
98        write!(
99            f,
100            "{}",
101            match self {
102                BarcodeFormat::AZTEC => "aztec",
103                BarcodeFormat::CODABAR => "codabar",
104                BarcodeFormat::CODE_39 => "code 39",
105                BarcodeFormat::CODE_93 => "code 93",
106                BarcodeFormat::CODE_128 => "code 128",
107                BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX => "datamatrix",
108                BarcodeFormat::EAN_8 => "ean 8",
109                BarcodeFormat::EAN_13 => "ean 13",
110                BarcodeFormat::ITF => "itf",
111                BarcodeFormat::MAXICODE => "maxicode",
112                BarcodeFormat::PDF_417 => "pdf 417",
113                BarcodeFormat::QR_CODE => "qrcode",
114                BarcodeFormat::MICRO_QR_CODE => "mqr",
115                BarcodeFormat::RECTANGULAR_MICRO_QR_CODE => "rmqr",
116                BarcodeFormat::RSS_14 => "rss 14",
117                BarcodeFormat::RSS_EXPANDED => "rss expanded",
118                BarcodeFormat::TELEPEN => "telepen",
119                BarcodeFormat::UPC_A => "upc a",
120                BarcodeFormat::UPC_E => "upc e",
121                BarcodeFormat::UPC_EAN_EXTENSION => "upc/ean extension",
122                BarcodeFormat::DXFilmEdge => "DXFilmEdge",
123                _ => "unsuported",
124            }
125        )
126    }
127}
128
129impl From<String> for BarcodeFormat {
130    fn from(value: String) -> Self {
131        value.as_str().into()
132    }
133}
134
135impl From<&str> for BarcodeFormat {
136    fn from(value: &str) -> Self {
137        match value.to_lowercase().as_str() {
138            "aztec" | "aztec code" | "aztec_code" => BarcodeFormat::AZTEC,
139            "codabar" | "coda" | "coda_bar" | "cod_a_bar" | "cod_a" => BarcodeFormat::CODABAR,
140            "code 39" | "code_39" | "code39" | "alpha39" | "code_3_of_9" | "uss_39" | "usd-3" => {
141                BarcodeFormat::CODE_39
142            }
143            "code 93" | "code_93" | "code93" => BarcodeFormat::CODE_93,
144            "code 128" | "code_128" | "code128" | "iso/ied 15417:2007" | "iso/_15417:2007" => {
145                BarcodeFormat::CODE_128
146            }
147            "datamatrix" | "data matrix" | "data_matrix" => BarcodeFormat::DATA_MATRIX,
148            "ean 8" | "ean_8" | "ean8" => BarcodeFormat::EAN_8,
149            "ean 13" | "ean_13" | "ean13" => BarcodeFormat::EAN_13,
150            "itf" | "itf_code" | "itf14" | "itf 14" | "itf_14" | "interleaved 2 of 5" => {
151                BarcodeFormat::ITF
152            }
153            "maxicode" | "maxi_code" => BarcodeFormat::MAXICODE,
154            "pdf 417" | "pdf_417" | "pdf417" | "iso 15438" | "iso_15438" => BarcodeFormat::PDF_417,
155            "qrcode" | "qr_code" | "qr code" => BarcodeFormat::QR_CODE,
156            "mqr" | "microqr" | "micro_qr" | "micro_qrcode" | "micro_qr_code" | "mqr_code" => {
157                BarcodeFormat::MICRO_QR_CODE
158            }
159            "rmqr" | "rectangular_mqr" | "rectangular_micro_qr" | "rmqr_code" => {
160                BarcodeFormat::RECTANGULAR_MICRO_QR_CODE
161            }
162            "rss 14" | "rss_14" | "rss14" | "gs1 databar" | "gs1 databar coupon"
163            | "gs1_databar_coupon" => BarcodeFormat::RSS_14,
164            "rss expanded" | "expanded rss" | "rss_expanded" => BarcodeFormat::RSS_EXPANDED,
165            "telepen" => BarcodeFormat::TELEPEN,
166            "upc a" | "upc_a" | "upca" => BarcodeFormat::UPC_A,
167            "upc e" | "upc_e" | "upce" => BarcodeFormat::UPC_E,
168            "upc ean extension" | "upc extension" | "ean extension" | "upc/ean extension"
169            | "upc_ean_extension" => BarcodeFormat::UPC_EAN_EXTENSION,
170            "DXFilmEdge" | "dxfilmedge" | "dx film edge" => BarcodeFormat::DXFilmEdge,
171            _ => BarcodeFormat::UNSUPORTED_FORMAT,
172        }
173    }
174}
175
176impl FromStr for BarcodeFormat {
177    type Err = crate::exceptions::Exceptions;
178
179    fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
180        let format = BarcodeFormat::from(s);
181        if format == BarcodeFormat::UNSUPORTED_FORMAT {
182            Err(crate::exceptions::Exceptions::FormatException(format!(
183                "Unsupported barcode format: {s}"
184            )))
185        } else {
186            Ok(format)
187        }
188    }
189}
